technical_choices: Use current installed Node 24.22.1 and exact npm metadata for Playwright 1.65.1 / Vue 2.6.12.
Existing repository Actions enabled, public, no self-hosted runners: ubuntu-24.04 standard public hosted runner; no paid capacity or policy changes.
source_invariants: Retain ptr storage key, layer registry/IDs, licenses and real Decimal semantics.
Missing known save fields use existing defaults; malformed present fields reject before active/durable mutation; no format migration or permanent compatibility mode.
Tick faults latch until reload; clearing ticking never silently resumes unsafe state.

user_outcome_journeys.task_and_start: Player with synthetic valid progress opens Options, imports or cancels New Save/Rename.
user_outcome_journeys.success: Valid import survives reload; cancellation changes neither active selection nor stored progress.
user_outcome_journeys.failure_recovery: Invalid input/storage failure preserves valid state and shows native keyboard-operable alert; player can retry valid input.
user_outcome_journeys.quality: Rendered Chromium, keyboard dismissal, 1280x800 and 320x800; no invented performance budget or actual-user claim.

user_outcome_journeys.failure_recovery: Bounded synthetic trace/report retained on failure; fix and rerun without skip/retry masking.
